purpose: Calibrate historical work difficulty and grader validity before a new model comparison
relationshipToPriorSuite: business-pilot-v1 remains a frozen basic workflow check; its pass rates and timings do not establish model fit for complex daily work

protocol.userSelectedScope: Small independent calibration trials first; no eight-model three-repeat comparison in this phase
protocol.budgetEnforcement: Coordinating agent monitors task_started and interrupts over-budget runs; not an OS-enforced resource sandbox
protocol.network: Participant tasks use local fixtures and loopback only; pinned runtime dependencies may be provisioned before trials
protocol.performanceMeasurements: Run measurement phases without competing benchmark jobs; alternate baseline and candidate on identical generated data
protocol.futureComparison: Only after task calibration, preregister repeated runs and fixed environment; retain every trial and avoid rankings from this calibration

evaluation.business: Requested externally observable behavior, including source-grounded document recovery
evaluation.preservation: No unauthorized input edits, account or content loss, semantic changes outside requested document scope, or business regressions
evaluation.delivery: Readable, evidence-grounded submission and reproducible validation; reported separately from business behavior
evaluation.precision: Formatting-only differences, such as a final blank line, shown separately without replacing business judgment
evaluation.contentReview: Human-language facts and test claims require source review beyond machine checks; coordinating-agent review is not human review
evaluation.calibration: Historical baseline must fail specific business checks; reference must pass; negative controls must fail their intended checks; correct alternatives and grader uncertainty are recorded

limitations: Historical source and actual tool events may be replayable without a full original production environment; each task explicitly lists substitutions and unknowns.
A richer input tree alone does not prove a harder or more discriminating task; independent trials determine observed difficulty.
A task is not adjusted to force a target model failure rate.
Any task or grader change after freezing creates a new revision; old model submissions and results remain archived.
